The '''187th Legion''', also known as '''Mace Windu's Attack Battalion''', was a [[Legion/Legends|legion]] of elite [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] that served under [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and a [[Unidentified Clone Commander (187th Legion)/Legends|clone commander]]. They were distinguished by the [[Color/Legends|purple]] markings on their [[Phase II clone trooper armor/Legends|armor]] which matched Mace Windu's [[Hurrikaine crystal|hurrikaine]] [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|lightsaber crystal]] in color.

==History==
===Siege of Dantooine===
Specifically trained to be capable of supporting their High [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] in battle, the 187th Legion participated in many strategic missions throughout the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Hasbro" />

At the onset of the Clone Wars, immediately after the [[Battle of Muunilinst/Legends|Battle of Muunilinst]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] began using the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] as a staging ground against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]. Learning of this Separatist presence, [[Master of the Order/Legends|Master of the Order]] Mace Windu dispatched an army of [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] to take back the planet. During the battle, the 187th Legion secured an important victory for the clone army, which allowed the Republic to take control of the planet.<ref name="Hasbro" />

===Battle of Coruscant===
During the final stages of the war, the Confederacy of Independent Systems launched a full scale [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|invasion]] on the Republic's [[Coruscant/Legends|capital]]. During the battle, the [[Droid Army|droid army]] began an assault on the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]]. The 187th Legion, led by their [[Unidentified Clone Commander (187th Legion)/Legends|clone commander]], fought to protect the temple.<ref name="Hasbro Target" />

==Equipment==
Troopers of the 187th Legion wore [[Phase II clone trooper armor/Legends|phase II clone trooper armor]] equipped with a communications antennae, and a command sash similar to [[Neyo/Legends|Neyo's]]. Their armor was adorned with light blue and purple markings, in a pattern very similar to that of [[Clone shock trooper/Legends|clone shock troopers]]. Some [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] also wore clone airborne armor, which included their [[Clone Commander|clone commander]]. They carried [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]] [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15S]] blaster carbines, [[DC-15A blaster rifle/Legends|DC-15A blaster rifles]], and [[DC-17 hand blaster/Legends|DC-17 hand blasters]].<ref name="Hasbro" />

==Behind the scenes==
In late [[2007]], [[Hasbro]] released an action figure box set, within their ''Ultimate Battles'' line, containing this legion of clone troopers. The set contained three troopers of the 187th Legion, and their [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]].<ref name="Hasbro Target" />
